purpose: Freeze the qualification-only authoritative steady one-dimensional Darcy face oracle before Ross table design and characterization.

theory_trace.primary_source: Ross PJ (2011), Numerical Solution of the Continuity Equation for Soil Water Flow Using Precomputed Steady-State Fluxes, Vadose Zone Journal 10:760-766, doi:10.2136/vzj2010.0085
source_semantics: vertical coordinate x is positive downward
steady face flux is obtained by integrating Darcy's law with constant q between prescribed endpoint states
for a uniform path the boundary-value solve may use h as independent variable
Ross gives the exact sign partition using h0 = h_below - path_length
q = K(h_above) at equal endpoint heads
runtime table lookup is separate from offline steady-Darcy table generation

hydraulic_trace.source_release: SWAP 4.3.1 frozen audit package supplied to this project

first_physical_fixture.hydraulic_model: default unimodal Mualem-van Genuchten with H_ENPR = 0 and no saturation switching inside the qualified envelope

oracle_numerics.root_method: bracketed scalar root solve using Ross sign bounds

independence_rules: do not import or copy F-LMFP06-10 table-generation or oracle implementation
LMFP results may be used only as later cross-evidence, not as implementation lineage
Ross table errors are measured against this direct steady-Darcy oracle, not against another interpolated table
